neighbours.label: Technical anatomical wording containing septal, coronary artery, blood vessel, fascicular, or atrioventricular.
fire: The ultrasound showed a ventricular septal defect in the newborn.
The cardiologist recommended a coronary artery bypass procedure.
The report described abnormal ventricular septal motion during contraction.
The examination revealed left anterior fascicular block.
The team investigated blood vessel disease after the scan.
The surgeon repaired the nasal septal opening yesterday.
The patient returned after coronary artery stent placement.
The specialist diagnosed an atrioventricular conduction block.
quiet: The ultrasound showed a hole between the lower heart chambers in the newborn.
The cardiologist recommended an operation to restore the blood supply to the heart.
The report described abnormal movement of the wall inside the heart during contraction.
The examination revealed delayed electrical conduction inside the heart.
The team investigated disease of the circulatory system after the scan.
The surgeon repaired the opening in the nasal partition yesterday.
The patient returned after ureteral stent placement.
The specialist diagnosed a blockage of the bile duct.

notes: Exploration found septal firing in nasal as well as cardiac contexts, so the hypothesis is lexical anatomical wording, not heart-specific meaning. Controls retain clinical style and paraphrase the technical terms. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory sentences are disjoint from this preregistered test.
